title: Research consolidation: exact historical J/kappa ranking census (no new kappa)
head: 419a92e2e3dd6b16e36694387c0e96ea900b5799
body:
Research consolidation / independent arithmetic verification; **no new κ**.

The archived campaign's nine J-versus-κ disagreements lacked an exact, independently replayable pair census. This package confirms all nine with new atanh-log and directed-integer moment intervals, resolves the pair denominator, and corrects one numerical bound in the original report.

- All **289,180** pairs of 761 design records are covered: **1,511 identical-histogram ties**, **287,660 agreements**, and **nine reversals**. The nine reversals represent **eight distinct histogram pairs** among 496 histograms.
- The reported `|ΔJ| ≤ 0.9` bound has a concrete counterexample: `u0089/u0302` has `0.9255615846 < |ΔJ| < 0.9255615847`. This leaves the original nine-reversal finding intact.
- Every distinct histogram has a strict rational moment bracket including all four idle ranks and the retained fallback. Historical floating J/κ scores never decide an ordering. The arithmetic κ map is bounded far enough to certify ordering, without claiming to recertify every stored final digit.

Only `research/historical-j-order-reconciliation/` is added. Original source bytes, attribution and AI disclosures are retained. The selected frontier and `upstream/` are unchanged.

### Reproduce

```sh
python3 -I -B research/historical-j-order-reconciliation/validate.py
```

Expected final marker: `PASS_HISTORICAL_J_RECONCILIATION_AND_CONTROLS`.

The census and **11 controls** pass on CPython 3.14.6 normally and 3.12.12 under `-O`. An isolated optimized relocation also passes with unchanged package bytes; falsified result receipts and output overwrites are rejected. All **five** selected-record tests and `make selected-record-check` pass. Eight GitHub blob identities and two archive-member hashes match their pins. Whitespace and one-package scope checks pass.

This does not regenerate or physically admit the 761 designs, replay all 47 historical constraints, verify the complex supplier, or discharge all-size/compiler, hosting, precision/tape and analytic assumptions. Full `make verify`, current-supplier cold replay, proof-assistant verification and remote CI success are not claimed.

OS-random seed **96**, research consolidation. No pinned coordination issue exists; the local claim is completed and links the result. The overlap review covered 713 open PR bodies through #923, then refreshed arrivals through #926 before submission. Adjacent #743/#828/#867/#907 address different objects.

Credit **Rohan Arun and the original campaign contributors** for the data and original nine-reversal observation, **DreamingOfClouds** for the p=10 package, and the five-stage/bank/supplier predecessors named in the preserved notices. This work corroborates their finding and adds exact coverage and the scoped correction. Prepared for **Ross Richardson (@RossRichardson)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, Apache-2.0. No independent human review or discovery priority for proxy misordering is claimed.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
